items.prompt: True or false: A right angle is a quarter turn.
hints: How many right angles make a whole turn?
The corner of a book is a right angle.
items.explanation: A whole turn is 4 right angles, so a right angle is a quarter turn.

items.prompt: True or false: A half turn is the same as a right angle.
hints: How many quarter turns make a half turn?
A half turn is bigger than a quarter turn.
items.explanation: A half turn is 2 right angles, because 2 quarter turns make a half turn. A right angle is a quarter turn.
